title: Convergence of Large-Stepsize SGD for the Cross-entropy Loss via Stochastic Lyapunov Stability
abstract: arXiv:2606.30930v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern deep learning has been shown to operate using learning rates far larger than those justified by classical optimization theory. Most prior analyses of this phenomenon focus on deterministic gradient descent, leaving the stochastic setting largely unexplored. In this work, we provide sharp convergence guarantees for Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) applied to the multiclass cross-entropy loss, for both linear classifiers and two-layer neural networks. We show that the stochasticity of SGD may cause the dynamics to alternate between an edge-of-stability regime that is dominated by curvature-driven oscillations, and a stable regime in which the expected loss decreases at a controlled rate. Despite that, we prove that SGD stabilizes the dynamics, ensuring that the iterates return to stability in a fixed number of iterations and allowing convergence in the best-iterate sense even with large learning rates. translated_title: 通过随机李雅普诺夫稳定性分析大步长随机梯度下降在交叉熵损失下的收敛性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.30930v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：现代深度学习已被证明能够以远超经典优化理论所能解释的学习率运行。以往对这一现象的大多数分析都集中在确定性梯度下降上，而随机设置在很大程度上尚未被探索。在这项工作中，我们为应用于多分类交叉熵损失的随机梯度下降（SGD）提供了精确的收敛保证，涵盖了线性分类器和两层神经网络。我们表明，SGD的随机性可能导致其动力学在由曲率驱动的振荡所主导的“稳定边缘”区域与期望损失以可控速率下降的稳定区域之间交替。尽管如此，我们证明了SGD能够稳定动力学，确保迭代点在固定的迭代次数内回归稳定，从而即使在学习率很大的情况下也能实现最佳迭代意义上的收敛。实验验证了我们的理论结果。
tldr: 本文借助随机李雅普诺夫稳定性理论证明，大步长SGD在多分类交叉熵损失下（含线性分类器和两层神经网络）虽会在“稳定边缘”振荡与稳定下降之间交替，但迭代点总能在固定次数内回归稳定，从而实现最佳迭代意义上的收敛。
en_tdlr: Using stochastic Lyapunov stability, this paper proves that large-stepsize SGD on multiclass cross-entropy loss—for both linear classifiers and two-layer neural networks—alternates between edge-of-stability oscillations and stable descent, yet the iterates return to stability within a fixed number of steps, guaranteeing best-iterate convergence even with large learning rates.
